question: Explain the purpose of the Comparable interface in Java.
answerMd:
### Comparable vs. Comparator in Java

| Comparison Parameter | `Comparable` (`java.lang`) | `Comparator` (`java.util`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Package** | `java.lang` | `java.util` |
| **Method** | `int compareTo(T other)` | `int compare(T o1, T o2)` |
| **Modification** | Modifies the **original class** definition. | Creates a **separate class / lambda** (original class untouched). |
| **Sorting Strategies** | Provides **single natural sorting order**. | Provides **multiple custom sorting orders** (by name, age, marks). |
| **Invocation** | `Collections.sort(list)` | `Collections.sort(list, comparator)` |

$$\therefore \text{Comparable defines natural ordering; Comparator defines flexible custom sorting strategies.}$$
